summary: Comprehensive testing of NexUacademy Landing Page, Admin Login from Main Page, and Contact Form features. All 16 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed - Landing page with all sections, contact form submission, admin login redirect to /admin, admin panel Teachers/Inquiries tabs, teacher/student login redirects, and root URL redirect to /landing.
seed_data_creation: Test contacts and teachers created during testing with TEST_ prefix
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing page at /landing is fully functional with hero, about, courses, founder, testimonials, contact, and footer sections. Contact form POSTs to /api/admin/contact (public endpoint). Admin login from /login with admin@nexuacademy.com/nexuacademy123 redirects to /admin panel. Admin panel has Teachers tab (create/list teachers) and Inquiries tab (view/respond to contact inquiries). Root URL / redirects to /landing for unauthenticated users. Teacher login redirects to /teacher, student login redirects to /dashboard.

admin_login_from_main_page.details: Admin login with admin@nexuacademy.com/nexuacademy123 from /login redirects to /admin

admin_create_teacher.details: Admin can create new teacher accounts from admin panel

admin_mark_responded.details: Admin can mark contact inquiry as responded

teacher_login_redirect.details: Teacher login from /login redirects to /teacher dashboard
